sources.title: TRELLIS-text-xlarge: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: A: TRELLIS-text-xlarge uses structured latent representations rather than direct geometry prediction, enabling scalable 3D generation from text alone. The structured approach prioritizes geometric coherence and generation stability, trading fine surface detail for consistency. Q: What file formats can I export the generated 3D geometry into?

sources.title: TRELLIS: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
sources.snippet: Our model generates high-quality results with text or image conditions, significantly surpassing existing methods, including recent ones at similar scales. We showcase flexible output format selection and local 3D editing capabilities which were not offered by previous models. Code, model, and data will be released.
